def refresh_toc(self, refresh_done_callback, toc_cache):
        """
        Initiate a refresh of the parameter TOC.
        """
        if toc_cache:
            toc = toc_cache
        else:
            toc = self.get_toc()

        if toc:
            self._toc_tree.set_root(toc)
            self._toc_tree.refresh()

            self._toc_tree.expand_to_path([])
            self._toc_tree.set_cursor([])

            self._toc_tree.refresh_done_callback = refresh_done_callback

            self._toc_tree.set_cursor([])
